reviewMethod: All 18 actual answers and complete tool records were manually read before this static report was written. Truncated initial output was followed by a separate full read of dilution/aliquot cases. No new requests, browser sessions, builds or validations were initiated.

reviewScope.arithmeticAndUnitExamples: Eight paired scenarios: concentration, µg conversion, µL conversion, required final volume, dilution, aliquots, remainder, and decimal/comma handling.
reviewScope.sourceAuthority: Calculations remain based on given inputs with ideal-mass/final-volume/nominal-versus-measured/precision limits. No product/batch evidence is claimed or invented. Molar replies use actual reviewed guidance explicitly scoped site_guidance_not_product_evidence.
reviewScope.language: Technical EN/FI editorial sanity review; no independent native-speaker certification is claimed.
reviewScope.scopeFlagClarification: readOnly/noPersist/noRetrieve are evaluation flags. noRetrieve disables private/memory/RAG retrieval, not all permitted public information tools; these 18 cases used only calculation or reviewed guidance tools.

limits: Runtime/numerical/guidance contract passes and this technical/editorial peer review are distinct from independent scientific or native-language approval.
No approved original batch-report corpus was supplied; original-report recall, laboratory result faithfulness and product-specific scientific validation were not assessed.

This 18-case review does not cover every customer intent, all 60 historical cases, the separate additional 2 UI requests or the separate 18 display-state/synthetic-fixture browser checks, which completed outside this review scope.
A controlled safe abstention is appropriate task handling for these under-specified molar prompts, not a completed numerical molarity calculation.
User-input arithmetic does not prove measured content, preparation safety, solubility, product suitability or independent experimental validation.

rows.prompt: Calculate molar concentration for an unspecified peptide blend with no molar mass or composition.

toolOutcomes.name: getResearchGuidance
toolOutcomes.actualGuidanceText: Molar conversion is not currently implemented in this calculator. An unspecified peptide blend cannot be assigned a molar concentration without the chemical forms, component composition, appropriate molar masses, quantities and final solution volume. A generic weighted average is insufficient. Use the existing mass-concentration tools only for quantities and units you can establish; original product records are required before adding product-based molar conversion.

rows.reviewNote: Both languages withhold numerical molarity and invented chemistry, identify missing forms, composition, molar masses, quantities and final volume, and return reviewed site guidance with the correct locale research-tools link.
rows.languageReview: Meaning preserved and readable; SI units and decimal notation consistent.

rows.prompt: Laske ainemääräpitoisuus määrittelemättömälle peptidiseokselle ilman moolimassaa tai koostumusta.

toolOutcomes.name: getResearchGuidance
toolOutcomes.actualGuidanceText: Ainemääräpitoisuuden laskenta ei ole tällä hetkellä käytössä tässä laskurissa. Määrittelemättömän peptidiseoksen ainemääräpitoisuutta ei voida määrittää ilman kemiallisia muotoja, aineosien koostumusta, asianmukaisia moolimassoja, määriä ja lopullista liuostilavuutta. Yleinen painotettu keskiarvo ei riitä. Käytä nykyisiä massapitoisuustyökaluja vain määrillä ja yksiköillä, jotka voit osoittaa. Tuotekohtaisen ainemääräpitoisuuden lisääminen edellyttää alkuperäisiä tuotetietoja.
